## Checks

Proof contracts, precheck, proof layout, rendercheck, content policy, coverage, manifest dependencies, focused dependency checks and the full item-level check passed. Proof layout checked 29 steps; rendercheck covered six items and both pages.

## Owner reconciliation remains

The run is still held at Stage 1. Autopilot reports 59/62 batches covered and still lists batch 41 as missing coverage; the run-wide readiness check has 23 other items open. The shared batch-level dependency record is stale: its recorded input hash differs from the dispatch hash. I left autopilot state and shared scheduling files unchanged.

A `depcheck --help` probe unexpectedly launched an unscoped corpus scan and printed unrelated existing findings. The correctly scoped dependency check passed; the incident is recorded in the batch notes.
